form.notes: Every numbered line of the 2025 face is declared (Sections A-D). Section A is personal-use property: line 15 is the ONLY line on this form that reaches Schedule D directly, and only where line 13 (personal casualty GAINS) exceeds line 14 (losses) — a net personal casualty GAIN. Section B is business and income-producing property and its results go to Form 4797. Schedule D lines 4 and 11 name this form on both sides ('short-term gain or (loss) from Forms 4684, 6781, and 8824' and the long-term equivalent), so the split between line 4 and line 11 is by holding period. Lines 2-9 and 20-27 print one column per property A-D (columns_are instances); line 29 and line 34 are rows of casualties with columns (a), (b)(i), (b)(ii), (c).
